name: GDTA 2026
description: The premier conference for design thinking professionals and students worldwide.

faq.question: What is GDTA 2026?
faq.answer: GDTA 2026 is the Global Design Thinking Alliance conference, bringing together design thinking professionals and students from around the world.

faq.question: When is the conference?
faq.answer: The conference takes place on March 15-16, 2026.

faq.question: Where is it located?
faq.answer: San Francisco Convention Center, San Francisco, USA.

faq.question: Who should attend?
faq.answer: Design students, design professionals, UX researchers, product designers, and anyone interested in design thinking methodologies.

faq.question: What are the different tracks?
faq.answer: We offer two tracks: Student track (focused on learning and career development) and Industry track (focused on professional practice and leadership).
